name: Esperion Therapeutic.Inc.(New)R
summary: Esperion Therapeutic.Inc.(New)R is a pharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing oral therapies for the treatment of elevated LDL-cholesterol (bad cholesterol). Their primary product is NEXLETOL (bempedoic acid), a non-statin drug that lowers LDL-C. The company is headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan, USA.
